basic_details.job_title: DHFWS Block Data Manager Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: District Health & Family Welfare Samiti, Rampurhat Health District, Health & Family Welfare Department (DHFWS), West Bengal, has invited applications for 2 posts of Block Data Manager under Advt No. 05/2026-2027. The online application is open from 13 November 2026 to 26 November 2026.

application_fee.details: Payment mode: Online through net banking / UPI payment or credit/debit card; non-refundable. Last date to pay the fee: 23 November 2026.

qualification.education_qualification: Graduate from any recognized university with at least 1 year Diploma in Computer Application from a Govt. registered institution; working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access and Internet; minimum 3 years experience in Government sector or 5 years in Private sector in data recording and data analysis.
qualification.details: Qualification: Graduate from any recognized university and at least 1 year Diploma course in Computer Application from Govt. registered Institution; working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point, MS Access and Internet; minimum 3 years experience in Government Sector or 5 years experience in Private Sector in data recording and data analysis. Experience: Minimum 3 years experience in Government Sector or 5 years experience in Private Sector in data recording and data analysis Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms | Other conditions:

exam_pattern.details: Marks calculated after rounding off up to 2 decimal points

how_to_apply: Apply online through www.wbhealth.gov.in; only online applications are accepted.
Pay the fee online using application ID and Date of Birth by 23/11/2026.
Re-login after successful payment for final submission by 26/11/2026.
Upload proper and full signature and photograph.
Download and keep the online registration form from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in; no need to send it by post.
important_instructions: Do not deposit the fee more than one time Pop-up must be accepted during registration/application Retain the Online Registration Number for future reference Updates posted on www.wbhealth.gov.in and www.birbhum.nic.in Queries to [email protected] or office visit Monday to Friday, 1.00 P.M. to 3.00 P.M. Competent authorities may cancel the recruitment process at any stage

content_sections.heading: Key Points
content_sections.text: Last date: 26 November 2026 Vacancies: 2 How to apply: Online Fee: General Caste: Rs.100; Reserved Category: Rs.50 Pay: Monthly consolidated remuneration Rs.22,000 Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Place: Block Public Health Unit under Rampurhat HD

content_sections.heading: DHFWS Block Data Manager Recruitment 2026 - Overview

rows.district_health_family_welfare_samiti_ra: Block Public Health Unit under Rampurhat HD

Graduate from any recognized university with at least 1 year Diploma in Computer Application from a Govt. registered institution; working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access and Internet; minimum 3 years experience in Government sector or 5 years in Private sector in data recording and data analysis.

content_sections.heading: DHFWS Notification PDF 2026
content_sections.text: Advt No. 05/2026-2027 gives the full conditions for the post, including anything not covered in the tables on this page. Read it before applying. The download link is in the Important Links table below. Download DHFWS notification PDF

content_sections.heading: Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Qualification: Graduate from any recognized university and at least 1 year Diploma course in Computer Application from Govt. registered Institution; working knowledge of MS Word, MS Excel, MS Power Point, MS Access and Internet; minimum 3 years experience in Government Sector or 5 years experience in Private Sector in data recording and data analysis. Experience: Minimum 3 years experience in Government Sector or 5 years experience in Private Sector in data recording and data analysis Age limit: 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026) Age relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms Other conditions:

content_sections.heading: Who Cannot Apply for DHFWS Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Essential qualification degree through Distant Learning Course or from any Open University will not be entertained Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms of Engagement
content_sections.text: Contractual post Panel valid for up to 1 (one) year from the date of publishing of the panel

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: Payment mode: Online through net banking / UPI payment or credit/debit card; non-refundable. Last date to pay the fee: 23 November 2026.

content_sections.heading: How Will DHFWS Select Candidates?
content_sections.text: Shortlisting on the basis of score of essential and desirable criteria Computer Test (qualifying marks 50%) Interview (wherever applicable) Class X: 5 marks, Class XII: 10 marks, Graduation: 15 marks - proportionate to percentage obtained, rounded off to 2 decimals Computer Test: 70 marks; total 100 marks Only shortlisted candidates will be called for computer test

content_sections.heading: DHFWS Exam Pattern 2026
content_sections.text: Marks calculated after rounding off up to 2 decimal points

content_sections.heading: Documents to Enclose
content_sections.text: Proper and full signature (uploaded) Photograph (uploaded) Print copy of online registration form for document verification Original testimonials for verification Caste / Disability / EWS Certificate issued by competent authorities of West Bengal

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for DHFWS Recruitment 2026 Online
content_sections.text: Apply online through www.wbhealth.gov.in; only online applications are accepted. Register online between 13/11/2026 and 23/11/2026. Pay the fee online using application ID and Date of Birth by 23/11/2026. Re-login after successful payment for final submission by 26/11/2026. Upload proper and full signature and photograph. Download and keep the online registration form from https://hr.wbhealth.gov.in; no need to send it by post.

content_sections.heading: Other Points to Note
content_sections.text: Do not deposit the fee more than one time Pop-up must be accepted during registration/application Retain the Online Registration Number for future reference Updates posted on www.wbhealth.gov.in and www.birbhum.nic.in Queries to [email protected] or office visit Monday to Friday, 1.00 P.M. to 3.00 P.M. Competent authorities may cancel the recruitment process at any stage

content_sections.heading: DHFWS Block Data Manager Recruitment 2026 - Important Links

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for DHFWS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date is 26 November 2026. Applications opened on 13 November 2026.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in DHFWS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 2 vacancies for Block Data Manager.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for DHFWS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Apply online through the link in the Important Links table, on or before 26 November 2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: General Caste: Rs.100. Reserved Category: Rs.50.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is 21 to 40 years (as on 1 January 2026). Relaxation: Reserved candidates As per govt. norms.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Monthly consolidated remuneration Rs.22,000.

faq.question: Q7. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Graduate from any recognized university with at least 1 year Diploma in Computer Application from a Govt. registered institution; working knowledge of MS Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Access and Internet; minimum 3 years experience in Government sector or 5 years in Private sector in data recording and data analysis.

faq.question: Q8. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Must be a permanent resident of West Bengal. Must be able to read, write and speak in Bengali. All essential qualifications must be obtained on or before publication of the advertisement. Qualifications must be from a recognized institute/University.

faq.question: Q9. Who cannot apply for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Essential qualification degree through Distant Learning Course or from any Open University will not be entertained. Candidates found ineligible at any stage will not be called for subsequent stages.

faq.question: Q10. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Shortlisting on the basis of score of essential and desirable criteria. Computer Test (qualifying marks 50%). Interview (wherever applicable). Class X: 5 marks, Class XII: 10 marks, Graduation: 15 marks - proportionate to percentage obtained, rounded off to 2 decimals.
